items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: John Popkin would say, “I’m sick of keeping you people in free coffee.”

ctx.x: And then all we got from the club would be cups of coffee. John Popkin would say, “I’m sick of keeping you people in free coffee.” He’d get mad if he lost at the racetrack.
He didn’t serve meals to you?
